dependencyTargets: Read references/version-targets.json from the installed skill on every build or upgrade. Resolve stable versions within those majors.
packageManager: npm (npm ci in CI; existing Yarn/pnpm repos keep their lockfile, Yarn 1 uses --frozen-lockfile)
node: Active LTS (resolve against the nodejs/Release schedule; audit.mjs reports drift)

secondary: winget (manifests owned by winget-manifests/apps.json, not by this repo)
distribution.windows: nsis (portable zip optional, never the updatable artifact)
distribution.macos: dmg (+ zip for Electron updater; .app.tar.gz for Tauri updater)

signing.tauriUpdaterKey: mandatory, never rotated without a bridge release
signing.windows: Azure Artifact Signing once public; unsigned only with a release-note warning
signing.macos: Developer ID + notarization; Tauri fallback ad-hoc ('-') with open instructions; Electron unsigned = no macOS auto-update
signing.linux: none at OS level; SHA256SUMS + provenance attestation

versionSource: git tag vX.Y.Z; package.json (and tauri.conf version '../package.json') asserted equal
release: single draft → verify → protected-environment approval → publish + make_latest → anonymous feed check
actionPins: major tags by default. Keep a repository requirement for exact versions or commit SHAs when updating the action.
immutableReleases: enabled once the pipeline is stable
notes: audit.mjs reads `platforms` and `deviations[]` only. rule == 'platforms' narrows the platform matrix; rule == <finding id> (e.g. windows-unsigned) moves that finding to 'accepted' (not counted in P0/P1/P2). A deviation without reason + revisitWhen is reported as drift. Everything else is guidance for the agent.
